info.name: FinSight API
info.description:
Complete API reference for FinSight — Privacy-First Personal Finance Intelligence Platform.
BSc Computing Systems Dissertation · Ulster University · 2026
Student: Farhan Bin Hossain · B00970291

USAGE:
1. Set the 'base_url' collection variable to http://localhost:5000 (local) or https://finance-tracker-dessertation.onrender.com (production)
2. Run POST /api/auth/login and copy the access_token into the 'token' collection variable
3. All protected endpoints use {{token}} automatically via the collection-level auth header

item.name: 01 · Authentication
item.description: User registration, login, Auth0 OAuth, profile, GDPR export and logout. Rate limited: 5/min register, 10/min login.

request.description:
POST /api/auth/register
Rate limited to 5 requests/minute per IP.
Password must contain uppercase, digit and special character.
Returns access_token + refresh_token on success.

POST /api/auth/login
Rate limited to 10 requests/minute per IP.
Returns access_token (1hr), refresh_token (7 days) and user object.
The test script automatically saves the token to the collection variable.
Login as admin user to test admin-only endpoints.

POST /api/auth/auth0-login
Exchanges an Auth0 id_token for a FinSight JWT.
Used by the frontend OAuth callback flow.

GET /api/auth/me — Protected
Returns the authenticated user's profile.
Requires valid Bearer token.

GET /api/auth/export — Protected
GDPR Article 20 data portability.
Returns all personal data as JSON: profile, transactions, budgets, goals, audit log.

POST /api/auth/logout — Protected
Logs out the user and records an audit event.

item.name: 02 · Transactions
item.description: Full CRUD for income and expense transactions. Soft delete — records are never hard deleted for audit trail compliance.

request.description:
POST /api/transactions — Protected
Create a new expense transaction.
The test script saves the returned id to {{transaction_id}}.
Valid categories: Food, Transport, Rent, Utilities, Entertainment, Shopping, Health, Subscriptions, Other

POST /api/transactions — Protected
Create an income transaction.

GET /api/transactions — Protected
Returns paginated transaction list.
Optional filters: type, category, start_date, end_date, limit, offset.
Enable the disabled query params to filter results.

GET /api/transactions/:id — Protected
Returns a single transaction owned by the authenticated user.

PUT /api/transactions/:id — Protected
Partial update — only include fields you want to change.

DELETE /api/transactions/:id — Protected
Soft delete — sets deleted:true and deleted_at timestamp.
Record is retained in MongoDB for audit trail.
Deleted transactions are excluded from ML forecasting and anomaly detection.

GET /api/transactions/summary/monthly — Protected
Returns spending by category + income vs expenses for the given month.
Powers the dashboard donut chart.

GET /api/transactions/anomalies — Protected
AT2 §3.3.4 — Statistical threshold method (mean + 2 standard deviations).
Flags unusual transactions per category with human-readable explanations.
Requires at least 5 transactions in a category to compute a reliable baseline.

GET /api/transactions/meta/categories — Public (no auth)
Returns all valid categories and transaction types.
Used by frontend dropdowns.

item.name: 03 · Budgets
item.description: Monthly category budgets with real-time spend tracking, percentage utilisation and alert thresholds.

request.description:
POST /api/budgets — Protected
Create a monthly budget for a spending category.
alert_threshold (default 80): percentage at which a warning alert fires.

GET /api/budgets — Protected
Returns all budgets for the current month with actual spend, remaining amount, percentage used and status (on_track / warning / over_budget).

PUT /api/budgets/:id — Protected
Update the limit or alert threshold for a budget category.

DELETE /api/budgets/:id — Protected
Removes a budget category.

item.name: 04 · Savings Goals
item.description: Goal-based saving with progress tracking, deposit history and deadline projection.

request.description:
POST /api/goals — Protected
Create a new savings goal with target amount and deadline.

GET /api/goals — Protected
Returns active goals first, then completed. Includes progress percentage and days remaining.

GET /api/goals/:id — Protected
Returns a single goal with full deposit history.

POST /api/goals/:id/deposit — Protected
Add a deposit to a savings goal. Updates saved_amount and records deposit history.

PUT /api/goals/:id — Protected
Partial update of goal name, target amount or deadline.

DELETE /api/goals/:id — Protected
Removes a savings goal.

item.name: 05 · AI Chat
item.description: Groq-powered (cloud) or Ollama-powered (local) financial assistant with persistent MongoDB-backed chat history. Switch via LLM_PROVIDER env variable.

request.description:
POST /api/chat — Protected
Sends a message to the AI assistant with financial context injected.
The LLM sees the user's recent transactions and responds contextually.
Response includes guardrail metadata (blocked, risk_level, pii_redacted).
LLM_PROVIDER=ollama → local Llama 3.1 (dissertation demo, no data leaves machine)
LLM_PROVIDER=groq → Groq cloud API (live deployment)

AT2 §2.1 — Conversational expense logging via natural language.
The LLM parses intent, extracts amount and category, and confirms the log.

GET /api/chat/history — Protected
Returns the full persistent conversation history for the authenticated user.

DELETE /api/chat/message/:id — Protected
Deletes a user message and its paired AI response by timestamp matching.

DELETE /api/chat/history — Protected
Clears the entire conversation history for the authenticated user.

item.name: 06 · Insights & Forecasting
item.description: ML-powered spending predictions with SHAP explainability. AT2 §3.3.4 — Random Forest regression + anomaly detection + natural language explanation.

request.description:
POST /api/insights/predict — Protected
AT2 Diagram 5 (Activity Diagram) flow:
  1. Retrieve active (non-deleted) transaction history
  2. Check data sufficiency (need 2+ months)
  3. Build feature matrix (9 category features + rolling averages)
  4. Train Random Forest Regressor
  5. Compute SHAP values for explainability
  6. Run anomaly detection (mean + 2 SD)
  7. Generate NL explanation via LLM (Groq or Ollama)
  8. Return full prediction payload

Response includes: predicted_total, confidence, top_drivers, category_shap, nl_explanation, budget_risk, anomalies

GET /api/insights/summary — Protected
Quick spending summary without ML inference.
Faster than /predict — used for lightweight dashboard widgets.

item.name: 07 · Alerts
item.description: Aggregated intelligent alert feed. AT2 §3.1 Must Have — intelligent alerts for overspending, anomalies and savings risks.

request.description:
GET /api/alerts — Protected
Aggregates three AT2-specified alert categories:
  1. Overspending — budgets with status over_budget or warning
  2. Anomalies — unusual transactions (mean + 2 SD per category)
  3. Savings risk — goals at risk of missing deadline (< 70% funded, < 30 days remaining)

Alerts sorted by severity (high first).
Response includes count and high_severity_count.

item.name: 08 · Admin
item.description: Admin-only endpoints. Requires a user with role: admin. Use the Login — Admin request first.

request.description:
GET /api/admin/stats — Admin only
Returns platform-wide statistics: total users, transactions, active sessions.

GET /api/admin/users — Admin only
Returns all registered users with account status.

GET /api/admin/users/:id — Admin only
Inspect a specific user's profile and activity.

POST /api/admin/users/:id/ban — Admin only
Suspends a user account.

DELETE /api/admin/users/:id — Admin only
Removes a user account.

GET /api/admin/transactions — Admin only
Platform-wide transaction view across all users.

GET /api/admin/charts — Admin only
Platform-wide analytics: donut chart by category, bar chart for monthly income vs expenses across all users.
